title: Warm and cold rollback standby
objective: Compare warm/cold rollback standby; detect a violated recovery promise.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Modern browser with local JavaScript; no server, account or framework
Fixed complete synthetic retention trace covers 0–300 seconds inclusive
Rollback request at synthetic second 240; required capacity is 10 units
Ready retained capacity must be fresh, compatible and sufficient throughout retention
actions: Choose warm, cold, insufficient-capacity or unobserved standby and a 6 or 24 second budget
Choose promise met, promise violated or unverified; check separate promise and answer verdicts
Compare fixed warm/cold references and inspect selected phase durations, capacity and retention gap
Reset current controls with keyboard or mouse while retaining every earlier outcome and original budget

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: Privately issued immutable in-memory state; current reset preserves history and fixed allowance

expectedAssertions: Warm ready compatible retained capacity meets the declared recovery budget
Cold readiness gap and 20 second recovery violate the original 6 second promise
A 24 second timing budget does not repair lost readiness inside retention
Fresh probes and fast timing cannot substitute for sufficient retained and recovered capacity
Missing selected readiness, compatibility and warm-up evidence yields unknown, not reference-derived success
A correct failure or unknown answer passes only its decision verifier
Success + failure + unknown equals all retained synthetic promise checks, including earlier failures after reset
Invalid input, unissued or altered state, duplicate decisions and excess checks cannot append a result
Actual isolated browser DOM, keyboard, announced errors, reset, retained history and restrictive CSP pass
limits: Fixed synthetic teaching data only; no actual standby, rollback, measured recovery, deployment or costs
No actual recovery-budget, user-journey, native Azure, source-parent or reliability certification
IaC N/A; no cloud, identity, credentials, deployment, spend, packages, framework or shared-root changes
Existing Node 22 tooling, offline Playwright 1.56.1 and signed Edge 156 only; not production Node 24
Read-only verification by default; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate capture only
